name: comp-384
title: Interactive Tooltip Popover
description: An outlined button opens a compact card above it with a bold heading, a short explanatory paragraph and a white action button. It is a popover styled to resemble a tooltip.
use: A short explanation needs an inline action, which a plain tooltip cannot host.
avoid: The popover has no arrow and can overlap content; it also needs a click rather than hover.
a11y: Keyboard opens and closes the popover and the inner button is reachable, but the panel is not labelled by its heading. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark popover floats above an outlined 'Tooltip-like popover' button on a near-black page. Inside is a bold heading, two lines of grey copy, and a small white 'Know more' button at the lower left; the panel has soft rounded corners and no arrow.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens the popover above it; clicking elsewhere or pressing Escape closes it. The Know more button is clickable but carries no action in the demo.
customise: The heading, paragraph and button label are fixed in the file; adapting the copy or adding a real action means editing the source.
weight: light: A small static panel and one button; no animation loop.
